draft_review.1_inner_comment_every_line: The draft matches the Java trace. TContext#buildCodeIterator (tim/TContext.java:325-330) builds it40 = CodeIteratorInnerComment over it30 = CodeIteratorShortComment; CodeIteratorInnerComment#peek (tim/iterator/CodeIteratorInnerComment.java:46-53) returns removeInnerComment() with no diagram-type test, and the procedure, legacy-define, while and foreach iterators (it61..it100) read it40's lines. execute_one_line now computes line_no_comment = remove_inner_comment(line) unconditionally, and the definelong, function, sub, while and foreach collectors all buffer line_no_comment. No change planned.
draft_review.2_theme_body_join: The draft joins every local-theme body, whatever the start type. Java joins only when checkEndingBackslash: PSystemBuilder#createPSystem (PSystemBuilder.java:210-212) passes types.contains(DiagramType.SEQUENCE), and UmlSource#loadInternal (core/UmlSource.java:118-134) otherwise copies the list unchanged. TContext#executeTheme (tim/TContext.java:725-745) runs the theme body through executeLines into the same result list, so the theme body is joined exactly when the top-level list is. The draft therefore joins theme continuations in, e.g., @startmindmap, where Java does not.
draft_review.3_unicode_15_letters: Verified. support/gen_bmp_letters.py regenerates the table from UnicodeData.txt 15.0.0 (sha256 806e9aed65037197f1ec85e12be6e8cd870fc5608b4de0fffd990f689f376a73, fetched from https://www.unicode.org/Public/15.0.0/ucd/UnicodeData.txt) and reports 48,965 BMP letters in 380 runs, equal to BMP_LETTER_RANGES. Against UnicodeData.txt 17.0.0 (sha256 2e1efc1dcb59c575eedf5ccae60f95229f706ee6d031835247d843c11d96470c) it lists exactly the sixteen added BMP letters U+088F U+0C5C U+0CDC U+1C89 U+1C8A U+A7CB U+A7CC U+A7CD U+A7CE U+A7CF U+A7D2 U+A7D4 U+A7DA U+A7DB U+A7DC U+A7F1, and none removed. BMP Nd is 370 code points in both versions, so BMP_DECIMAL_DIGIT_ZEROS (37 runs of 10) is unaffected. unicode-properties leaves rustuml-parser; Cargo.lock keeps it only as rustybuzz's own dependency (text shaping, not the header test).
